description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'EditorFragment' responsible for editing notes within a note-taking app. It manages UI components, user interactions, note data binding, markdown editing, attachments, tasks, and various note operations such as archiving, deleting, sharing, and color changes.

classes.name: EditorFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class for editing notes, managing UI, user interactions, markdown, attachments, tasks, and note operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes shared element transitions and postpones enter transition.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the view, initializes data, RecyclerViews, observers, listeners, and handles fragment result listeners.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the top menu and sets up menu items based on note data.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for note operations like archive, delete, share, color change, etc.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Saves current selection range of the note content.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up resources, dismisses snackbar, detaches helpers, resets UI states.

methods.name: setupTasksRecycler
methods.description: Initializes the tasks RecyclerView and its adapter with drag-and-drop and swipe support.

methods.name: setupAttachmentsRecycler
methods.description: Initializes the attachments RecyclerView and its adapter with item click and long-press actions.

methods.name: setMarkdownToolbarVisibility
methods.description: Controls visibility of markdown formatting toolbar based on note state.

methods.name: setupEditTexts
methods.description: Configures title and content EditTexts, including text watchers, focus, and input behaviors.

methods.name: setupMenuItems
methods.description: Adjusts menu item visibility and labels based on note state.

methods.name: observeData
methods.description: Collects and reacts to ViewModel data updates, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Sets up UI event listeners for formatting actions, notebook selection, and task addition.

methods.name: setupMarkdown
methods.description: Initializes markdown text watcher for live markdown editing.

methods.name: enableMarkdownTextWatcher
methods.description: Attaches markdown text watcher to the content EditText.

methods.name: disableMarkdownTextWatcher
methods.description: Detaches markdown text watcher from the content EditText.

methods.name: setupScreenAlwaysOn
methods.description: Enables or disables screen always-on flag.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures toolbar navigation and back press handling.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task at specified position.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates task content or status, and reorders if needed.

methods.name: showColorChangeDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to change note color.

methods.name: showRemindersDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with note reminders and options to add or edit.

methods.name: checkSchedulePermission
methods.description: Checks and requests permission to schedule exact alarms.

methods.name: requestFocusForFields
methods.description: Focuses the note body if empty or forced.

methods.name: updateEditMode
methods.description: Switches between view and edit modes, updating UI components accordingly.

methods.name: hasNoteEmptyContent
methods.description: Checks if the note content is empty or list is empty.

methods.name: uncheckAllTasks
methods.description: Marks all tasks as unchecked.

methods.name: removeAllCheckedTasks
methods.description: Removes all tasks marked as checked.

search-terms: Note convert between list and text
